projects.title: CyberResponse v2
projects.summary: Casework platform backend with AI agents.
projects.description:
Designed the backend around a core case API, wrapped by an MCP server that exposes 5+ case-management tools to Python workflows.

Enforced safe state transitions: every agent action passes schema validation and human approval before any case-state change.

Orchestrated a LangGraph supervisor on Azure OpenAI coordinating triage and evidence agents with per-case memory.

Tested on 150+ simulated scenarios with LangSmith: 99% schema adherence; a self-correction step lifted first-pass approval from 65% to 88%.

projects.title: CyberResponse
projects.summary: Fraud reporting platform, published at IEEE ICoECIT 2026.
projects.description:
Co-built a fraud intake platform as microservices (API, AI worker, notifications) with Redis and PostgreSQL, ML-based classification, real-time case tracking and an operator admin dashboard.

Published at IEEE ICoECIT 2026 (DOI: 10.1109/ICoECIT68303.2026.11497960).

highlights: Shipped embedding-based semantic job matching (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and pgvector) as the platform's core feature for 100+ candidates and recruiters, replacing keyword search across 500+ job listings.
Built the core backend in Java Spring Boot (20+ REST endpoints, PostgreSQL schema) calling a separate Python FastAPI embedding microservice, and documented the APIs with OpenAPI.
Worked in an Agile Scrum team, taking part in sprint planning, standups and code reviews on pull requests.

Owned debugging of a production latency issue: profiled with OpenTelemetry and Spring Boot Actuator, found pgvector search took 5 ms while an ORM N+1 query caused 850 ms, and cut p95 latency to 120 ms with JPA batch fetching.
Built fault-tolerant service calls between Spring Boot and FastAPI using Resilience4j circuit breakers and exponential backoff, with automatic fallback to PostgreSQL full-text search during outages.
Improved precision@5 by about 20% over the keyword baseline through evaluation, error analysis and 100+ test cases, and iterated the pipeline after user feedback revealed seniority-level mismatches.
Owned deployment of the services in Docker alongside React and Next.js UIs, and presented accuracy versus latency trade-offs to leadership, securing sign-off to launch matching as the core feature.
Replaced manual pre-release checks with GitLab CI/CD pipelines running automated test suites on every code change.
Built Java Selenium and TestNG regression suites covering 40+ workflows.
Validated 100K+ records in Python and SQL, catching 2,500+ data quality issues before they reached downstream systems.
